summary: Contemporary 3-bed mid-link family home featuring a living room, dining kitchen, family bathroom, and en-suite shower room. Book a viewing today!
description:
Deceptively spacious, this immaculately presented townhouse would make the ideal family home for those looking to reside within easy reach of Carlisle city centre.

Finished in modern and neutral tones, this property is ready for new occupants to make their own. The property benefits from 3 double bedrooms however one of these could easily be used as a home office and provide a quality home working environment, or equally this family home is large enough for those with an older family.

The property also has an enclosed garden to the rear of the property which is accessed through French doors from the kitchen diner.

The property benefits from 2 allocated parking spaces to the front of the house, and is within a 10 minute walk of convenience stores and the city centre.

Directions From the city centre, head south on Botchergate / London Road. Continue past St Nicholas gate retail park before turning left onto St Cuthbert's Street. Continue round Oswald Street turning right at the end onto Linton Street. Turn right again onto Lindisfarne Street and left after the pub onto Tramside Way and second right onto Farneside Close.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
